city_center.landmark: the Kamas Valley pastureland below the Uinta Mountains, the western gateway to the Mirror Lake Highway and the Uintas; Ballerina Farm scratch-dairy country
city_center.notes: Kamas Valley is a working ranch-and-dairy valley on the Wasatch Back, 15-20 minutes east of Park City over the pass; Ballerina Farm (scratch dairy, fresh butter, raw honey) is the signature local farm.
